A '''secret laboratory''' was owned by the scientist [[Derg Prantis]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|Derg didn't know who to trust so he thought of me. We go back a few years.  He wanted me to get to the laboratory and evacuate his staff and destroy evidence before assassin teams arrived.|Cale Herron, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TP" />}}
[[File:SecretLaboratory2.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A view inside the laboratory's perimeter.]]
By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooinian]] biologist Derg Prantis obtained a sample of the dreadful [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] from an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] scientist.<ref name="SWG:TP" /> The Empire had secretly recruited a group of scientists on the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] to turn the virus into a [[bioweapon]].<ref name="SWG:ID">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Investigate Dathomir|Lok}}</ref> Prantis therefore built a secret laboratory on the remote planet [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] to conduct his own research on the virus in order to create a super soldier drug.<ref name="SWG:TP" />

Derg Prantis was soon betrayed by his lab assistant, [[Bera Jeza]], who contacted the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|Crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] to sell him the super soldier drug. Having discovered the betrayal, the scientist requested his long time associate [[Cale Herron]] to help him evacuate his secret lab and destroy evidence.<ref name="SWG:TP" /> However, the lab was brutally attacked before Herron could intervene and the entire staff was assassinated.<ref name="SWG:FC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Find Clues|Lok}}</ref> Prantis eventually returned to Tatooine.<ref name="SWG:BJE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Bera Jeza's Employer|Tatooine}}</ref>

[[File:SecretLaboratory3.jpg|200px|thumb|A mysterious datapad next to the body of a dead Twi'lek.]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Derg Prantis was [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] in the [[Mos Eisley Biolab]].<ref name="SWG:BJE" /> A [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] investigating the crime later encountered the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] Cale Herron. The latter tasked the spacer with traveling to Lok and searching for clues in the secret laboratory.<ref name="SWG:TP" /> The spacer ended up finding a mysterious [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] next to the body of a [[Death/Legends|dead]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]].<ref name="SWG:FC" /> The investigation finally led to the discovery of the [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir]].<ref name="SWG:ID">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Investigate Dathomir|Lok}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Secret Laboratory appeared as a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TP" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Secret Laboratory was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 13|Game Update 13]]," released on [[September 30]], [[2009]].<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1003113|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies: Game Update 13 -- Chronicle Master System}}</ref> This location was part of the questline "[[W:c:swg:Something is Obviously Wrong|Something is Obviously Wrong]],"<ref name="SWG:TP" /> an introduction to the "[[W:c:swg:Death Troopers|Death Troopers]]" [[W:c:swg:Game Update 14|update]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 14: Death Troopers">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1008376|text=Game Update 14: Death Troopers}}</ref>
